title.narrative: Supporting the resilience capacity of youth and women in Gao and Timbuktu regions after armed conflict

description.narrative: As a joint programme of UNIDO and UNDP, the main objective of this project is to consolidate the reconciliation and peacebuilding process in Northern Mali. In this regard the project will provide the following main outputs: 1-Targeted youth and women benefit from spaces for discussion, exchange, trainings and are involved in the facilitation of groups of discussion (UNDP) 2-Youth and women organizations benefit from the technical and operational skills, required for dialogue promotion, mediation, preve ntion and conflict resolution (UNDP) 3-Youth and women benefit from income generating activities through the implementation of high intensity labour works (UNDP) 4-Youth acquire skills needed by the local job market based on the results of mapping business opportunities/ sectors with growth and employment potential (UNIDO) 5-Young entrepreneurs are assisted in the creation and development of their micro enterprise through financial and non-financial means (UNIDO) 6-Women benefit from Income Generating Activities through enhanced business networks and agricultural cooperatives (UNIDO) The project will be funded by the PBF (United Nations Peacebuilding Fund) and intervenes is the framework of the immediate response facility within 18 months (IRF) as designed by the PBF.
